kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Aramaic אַרְדְּבָא / ܐܪܕܒܐ (ʾardəḇā), from Akkadian 𒅈𒁕𒁉 (/⁠ardabu⁠/, “capacity measure of about 56 litres”), whence also Ancient Greek ἀρτάβη (artábē).
s: Akkadian 𒅈𒁕𒁉 (/⁠ardabu⁠/, “capacity measure of about 56 litres”)
g: a dry measure, artab, chiefly used in Egypt and varying but fixed in the 20th century at 198 liters
